plugins.name: Jev
plugins.description: Jev, TypeSafe's cheap typed classifier, as the "jev" plugin service: other plugins ask choice, yes/no and score questions (one request, or a grid over many items). OpenRouter, TypeSafe direct or a custom endpoint; usage counted per calling plugin, with a monthly spending cap. Choices only, no free-form text generation.
plugins.author: BronOS
